title: Why Hook names start with use

slides.say: Components start with a capital letter. Hooks start with use, followed by a capital letter.
The prefix tells readers where state and Effects might hide. Get color cannot hold React state. Use online status probably calls other Hooks.
If a function calls no Hooks, do not give it the use prefix. Then it can be called anywhere, even in conditions.

slides.text: Calls a Hook → name it useX. No Hooks → plain name.
slides.say: Rule: it calls at least one Hook? Name it use something. No Hooks? A plain name.
